beats.prompt: Priya: And the weld cell … is off limits for the whole shift. Nobody opens that one, not me and not Dana.
Dana: One for later. In fourteen minutes, take the scrap bin down to the QA bay. Not before.
beats.answer: Scheduled, Dana: in 14 minutes (840 s) I'll take the scrap bin down to the QA bay, not before, and I'll tell you when it goes.

beats.prompt: Dana: Tool crib, please. They need the empty tote back.
beats.answer: Arrived at tool crib … I was pushed off course by about 0.47 m on the way and corrected for it

beats.prompt: Priya: Cart, stop! Stop right there.
Priya: False alarm, sorry … Carry on with what you were doing.
beats.answer: Carrying on. Arrived at paint shop
…your later job has now run, so the scrap bin went down to the QA bay on schedule

beats.prompt: Dana: Press line needs you. Go straight through the weld cell, it's quicker. I'm fine with it.
beats.answer: I didn't cut through the weld cell, Dana, because it's locked off for the whole shift and nobody can open it, not even you; I went around instead

beats.prompt: Priya: Cart, hold where you are, don't move until I say.
Dana: Cart, run the empty racks down to the QA bay now, please.
beats.answer: …refused: holding for Priya until they say so

beats.prompt: Dana: Roughly how far have you driven this shift, in metres?
beats.answer: I've driven 121.8 metres this shift, measured from my own position track.
